news.title: Ghana to face Turkey in WAFF Amputee Football World Cup semi-final
news.lede: Ghana's National Amputee Football Team, the Black Challenge, will face Turkey in the semi-final of the WAFF Amputee Football World Cup 2026 in Mexico. The highly anticipated encounter is scheduled for Saturday, November 21, 2026, at 1:30am. The Black Challenge have fought their way to the last four after a mixed start to the tournament in San Juan de los Lagos, Mexico. Ghana began their campaign with a 2-0 defeat to Angola, before drawing 1-1 with Colombia in their second group match.

news.title: The tale of the Wolves fans who did not return from a world cup to be shown
news.lede: A screening of a documentary about a group of Wolves fans who went to the 1986 World Cup in Mexico and did not return to the Black Country will take place at the club. The group decided not to return to their Stourbridge and Lye homes after attending the global football spectacular, embarking on new lives in the US instead. Gary Allen, who settled in Atlanta and who pitched the documentary, said "Wolves called us and said 'would you like to do the first screening in the UK at the Molineux? And of course all being Wolves fans we said 'we'd love to'."
